$schema: informational only — this file documents the design system used by assets/design-b-full as a handover reference for Elementor / production build. Not consumed at runtime.

_meta.name: Solpaċi B — Color Studio
_meta.scope: design-tokens only — does not include business data (shade names, prices, copy)
_meta.notes: Tokens reference values from styles.css :root. Hex values are stable reference; spacing/typography use fluid clamp() that browsers resolve at runtime. Implementations must re-derive concrete values from the same source. Final brand assets (logo, font license, photographs) and copy are pending client ACC.

cream.description: Base canvas background. Hero copy side, sections, document body.

pink.description: Medium pink panel surface. Hero art, story panel, footer top, catalog aside.

pinkDeep.description: Deeper pink variant for hover/secondary accents.

paper.description: Lightest neutral. Input fields, gallery notes, summary cards.

ink.description: Primary text color. Headings, primary buttons, footer statement, outlines.

accent.description: Maroon accent. Hover states, price emphasis, editorial quote em.

bar.description: Pop accent (sparingly used, e.g. eyebrow high-contrast moments).

tints._documentation: Fictional study shades only. Final palette, names and prices pending client ACC.

shadeTile.notes: Four demo shade colors used by swatch / shade-picker.

borderExtra.notes: Translucent black for image-label subtle edge.

sans.role: Body, UI controls, captions, eyebrows, buttons

gutter.description: Outer page padding applied to header, sections, footer.

gap._desc: Common flex/grid gaps observed in the build.

hairline.scope: Faint dividers, image-label border, secondary hairlines inside cards.

rule.scope: Default border for product cards, panels, buttons, summary, choices, footer strips.

heavy.scope: Frame separators between major sections (header bottom, hero divider, story divider, footer top, closing-CTA borders).

default.scope: Buttons, inputs, panels, summary cards, swatches, choices, alerts.

pill.scope: Same as default — B is square-edged throughout (contrast to typical rounded kutek DTC sites).

card.description: B is hard-edged / poster-like. No drop shadows anywhere; depth conveyed by borders, color panels, and overlap instead.

animation._principle: Subtle, uses prefers-reduced-motion to disable transitions.
animation.reducedMotion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) → all transition and animation removed.

wide.behavior: Adds a 1px side border around the centered page shell.

tablet.behavior: Compresses gutters and grids for medium screens.

mobile.behavior: Single-column, hamburger menu, summary becomes non-sticky.

iconography._desc: Inline SVG only — no external font icons. Plus glyph '+' / '−' / '×' used for swatch selector, quantity, and FAQ toggle.

assets._desc: All assets live offline under ./images. No CDN, no remote font.

preview._desc: Boundaries of what the design-preview can claim.
available: Interaction patterns (cart, filter, language switch, mobile menu, shade picker)
Accessibility helpers (skip link, focus outline, prefers-reduced-motion)

forProduction: Adopt these tokens as Elementor Global Styles; keep the heavy 2-4px border system, the medium-pink panel surfaces, and the sans-serif bold heading style.
Replace the localStorage cart and demo checkout with WooCommerce + Midtrans + Biteship implementations.
Translate copy via Polylang instead of the inline ID/EN pair arrays.
Swap demo shade data for production SKUs, names, prices once client confirms.
Re-test mobile-first (390px) and desktop (1440px) after every token change.
forClaude: Convert inline ID/EN pairs to Polylang string-table entries.
Map CSS variables 1:1 to Elementor site settings → global colors / typography / spacing.
Preserve offline behaviour: no CDN fonts or remote images.
Use placeholder imagery until client delivers photographs.
Keep border weights (hairline/rule/heavy) intact — they carry the poster language.
